artifactApprovalStatus: All 33 candidate production images were generated, reviewed as one visual family, optimized, and integrated on 2026-08-27. Exact generated versions still require founder review before any canon promotion or rights-sensitive external use; no lore-canon, manufacturing, or blanket publication status is inferred.

productionIntegration.mode: generated new images plus three targeted consistency edits
productionIntegration.processing: center-cropped from retained PNG masters and encoded as WebP at quality 86 / effort 6

referenceBinding.formalRegistryStatus: Not Canon / Historical visual reference / Needs Truth / internal reference and archive-informed generation only
referenceBinding.passTreatment: Positive visual authority for Bizi automaton form, sacred machinery, sepia civic infrastructure, Byzantine-derived architecture, and hand-rendered atmosphere.
referenceBinding.transformationRule: Synthesize the family rather than copying a single composition. Remove accidental embedded lettering, generic Victorian steampunk, anime or photographic drift, and real-world religious insignia.

conflictLedger.conflict: The active Card Registry contains Focus, Hera, and Constanti but none of the 18 constructed replacement cards implemented in the repository.
conflictLedger.resolutionForThisPass: Illustrate the 18 constructed cards as implementation-bound content. Do not change mechanics or claim registry/canon promotion.

conflictLedger.conflict: C-49 establishes Bizi as Byzantine first while the lower faction guide emphasizes routes, rails, delivery, bread, and administration.
conflictLedger.resolutionForThisPass: Byzantine civilization controls architecture, historical scale, institutions, and sacred machinery. Logistics appears as lived civic material culture, never as the replacement identity or a delivery-app joke.

conflictLedger.conflict: ASSET-019 is historically Not Canon and rights-unverified, but it is the closest available Bizi visual family.
conflictLedger.resolutionForThisPass: Use it as the closest governing visual reference by explicit founder instruction while retaining candidate output, rights review, and exact-version approval gates.

conflictLedger.conflict: The repository chapters contain Byzantine-derived roles and events that could become one-to-one historical reenactment.
conflictLedger.resolutionForThisPass: Preserve story function and sequence but transform flags, religious symbols, named Earth places, costume, machinery, and causal detail into original Bizi civilization design.

conflictLedger.conflict: The implementation card name may imply Voltari identity, while C-49 forbids collapsing Bizi Titans or civilization identity into alien aliases.
conflictLedger.resolutionForThisPass: Depict a Bizi civic-military electrical ultimatum without Voltari beings, insignia, or alien identity.

sharedVisualContract.style: Premium hand-painted historical watercolor and ink illustration, carrying forward the warm authored character of the early Kaiser and Meerus art while preserving the recovered Bizi family's automata, sacred machinery, and sepia infrastructure.
sharedVisualContract.identity: A Byzantine-first automata civilization in which maintenance, administration, faith, bread, routes, engineering, repair, and ordinary labor become historical forces.
sharedVisualContract.palette: Sun-aged cream, transit blue, tile red, workwear navy, oxidized brass, dark iron, parchment tan, stamped black, and selective electric amber.
sharedVisualContract.materials: Brass and copper mechanisms, dark iron, ceramic tesserae, enamel signs without lettering, worn limestone, parchment route sheets without readable text, leather, linen workwear, bread crust, ash, and oil smoke.
mustPreserve: Bizi-specific automaton anatomy and occupational purpose
Byzantine-derived civic and sacred architecture transformed into an original civilization
ordinary workers, clerks, engineers, soldiers, and repair crews as dignified historical actors
Machina, Melech, and Meca as distinct Bizi Titans without alien aliases
foundation, system-building, overextension, fracture, repair, restoration, and fall
clear subjects and silhouettes at thumbnail scale
mustAvoid: anime mecha or glossy mobile-game splash art
modern trains, computers, power plants, delivery apps, or factories without transformation
real-world flags, crosses, crescents, halos, scripture, rulers, or named historical locations
embedded text, fake lettering, logos, watermarks, card UI, borders, or labels
random gears used as decoration without functional logic
excessive sepia monochrome that erases tile blue and red

variantPolicy: One canonical illustration per constructed gameplay card. Standard and collector-foil variants share one art path; finish is presentation-only.
